session_spawn.title: Hand work to an agent
session_spawn.description: Start an agent on a task: a session, the entry that asks for a provider, a model and an effort, and the session's claim on the task. The agent is launched by the commit, so a task somebody else holds refuses the whole thing. Say wait and the answer is what the run came to — its brief and its exit code — instead of its id.

task.description: the work it is being handed, which it claims

provider.description: who runs it — a provider whose transport is a command here

model.description: which model it serves the run with

effort.description: how hard to think, where the model takes such a word

instruction.description: what to tell it (default the task's id and title — it holds the claim and reads the rest itself)

wait.description: block until the run is over and answer with its ending

timeout.description: how long to wait — 45m, 2h, or bare seconds (default 30m)

session_wait.title: Block until it is over
session_wait.description: Wait for a session to end, and answer with what it came to: its brief and the exit code its run ended on. A session still going when the timeout passes is answered as still going, never killed.

timeout.description: how long to wait — 45m, 2h, or bare seconds (default 30m)

session_peek.title: A glance at the transcript
session_peek.description: The tail of a session's transcript as the graph holds it, one line per entry, plus what it is doing. A bounded glance at the entries, never the provider's own log file.
